title: VitalSync
summary: A closer connection between patients and the people caring for them.
description: VitalSync brings readings from connected sensors into a web app. Doctors and family members get a shared view of patient vitals, with alerts for readings that need attention.

screens.caption: Choose a doctor or family portal

title: ArchiveX
summary: Keep track of where your documents and assets actually live.
description: ArchiveX is a physical file and asset management system built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Track where documents, folders, and boxes are stored, with search by name, location, and notes, and filtering by type and category. Integrated with Better-auth and Neon for authentication and database storage.

title: Pokédex
summary: A familiar world, made easy to explore.
description: A Pokémon explorer built with React Native and Expo. Browse the first generation, search by name, and view stats, types, and sprites using PokéAPI. These are screenshots of the project, which is separate from this React + Vite portfolio.

title: Objet
summary: A considered storefront for objects that earn their place.
description: An editorial homeware ecommerce concept with catalogue search and filters, product variants, inventory-aware quantity controls, a persistent shopping bag, and a server-priced test checkout.

screens.caption: Product variants, inventory, and purchase controls

title: Tempo
summary: A little less mental clutter. A clearer idea of what comes next.
description: A task and reminder manager that separates urgent, overdue, and upcoming work. The dashboard keeps priorities visible, while individual task views keep the details close.
